name: Nyan Café Macchiato ~Neko ga Iru Café no Ecchi Jijou~
original_name: にゃんカフェマキアート ～猫がいるカフェのえっち事情～
source:
Kouya’s life is full of misfortune. Every company he works for ends up going bankrupt and his apartment went up in flames. Now he’s a lecturer-in-training at Kaminekosaka Academy and also helps out at his grandfather’s neko café Nekotama-ya, which is staffed by three beautiful girls: the energetic Mike, the timid Ameri and the milady Persia. All three of them had feelings for him, and due to his misfortune, they all confessed to him at the same time. He didn’t want to lose this lucky chance and they all ended up spending the night together as a foursome. The next morning was the beginning of a new relationship between the four of the them, with all three girls being his lover at the same time!

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/08/01/august-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
寇亚的一生充满了不幸。他工作的每一家公司最终都破产了，他的公寓也被烧毁了。现在，他是神高坂学院的实习讲师，还在他祖父的猫咖啡馆Nekotama-ya帮忙，咖啡馆里有三个漂亮的女孩：精力充沛的迈克、胆怯的阿梅里和夫人波斯。三个人都对他有感情，又因为他的不幸，同时向他表白。他不想失去这个幸运的机会，最后他们四人一起度过了一夜。第二天一早，四个人就开始了新的关系，三个女孩同时成为了他的情人！

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/08/01/august-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
